# Trump approval hits record second-term low: Survey

#### White House Headlines - November 13, 2026

President Trump’s job approval rating sits at a second-term low in a new postelection survey, showing little sign of improvement after his party suffered widespread losses in the midterms.

In the new Economist/YouGov poll, 63 percent of Americans said they disapproved of Trump’s job performance, including 52 percent who disapproved strongly, with just 32 percent approving. [...] The Economist/YouGov survey was conducted among 1,685 U.S. citizens from Nov. 9 to 11. Its margin of error is 3 points.

# Trump approval rating remains stuck near career low in new poll

President Donald Trump's approval rating remains near the lowest of his political career for the fourth consecutive Reuters/Ipsos poll, with less than one in three Americans approving of his performance in his second term.

The poll, released on Nov. 16, found that 32% approved of Trump’s job performance, only one percentage point above his career low of 31% in Reuters/Ipsos tracking. [...] Trump’s stagnant approval rating in the latest Reuters/Ipsos poll comes as several national polling averages show substantially more Americans disapproving than approving of his job performance.
